title: Eurozone Final CPI & Trade Balance
desc: The official read on European inflation. Divergence between ECB and Fed policy is a primary driver of the DXY. A cooler European CPI locks in the ECB rate cut narrative, which could artificially prop up the Dollar Index and suppress BTC in the short term.

title: US Building Permits & Housing Starts
desc: Housing data acts as a leading indicator for systemic economic health. Severe weakness here signals that sustained high yields are fracturing structural economic pillars, potentially forcing a dovish pivot sooner than the market anticipates.

title: FOMC Meeting Minutes Release
desc: A critical look under the hood of the Fed's latest policy discussions. Institutional algos will parse the text for 'sticky inflation' vs 'easing' rhetoric. Expect high-frequency volatility spikes across both DXY and BTC trading pairs the moment the minutes hit the wire.

title: Pyth Network (PYTH) Major Unlock
desc: A massive scheduled cliff unlock for the oracle network. With millions of tokens entering circulating supply, watch for immediate spot pressure and potential 'sell the news' volatility bleeding into the broader Solana DeFi ecosystem.

title: US Initial Jobless Claims
desc: Labor market resilience is the final anchor for the 'Higher for Longer' hawkish narrative. An unexpected spike in jobless claims could accelerate the 'bad news is good news' cycle for digital assets, shifting capital back toward scarce assets.

title: US Flash PMIs (Manufacturing & Services)
desc: A real-time snapshot of economic momentum. If the Services PMI drops into contraction (<50), expect a swift downward revision in GDP growth models, triggering a potential aggressive bid for both Treasury bonds and Gold as risk-off hedges.

title: Space ID (ID) & Immutable (IMX) Supply Unlocks
desc: Weekend liquidity is typically thin, making these weekend token unlocks particularly dangerous for localized price action. Expect isolated volatility and potential aggressive funding rate manipulation on perpetual futures markets.

title: BitLogic Alpha Weekly Macro Review
desc: Synthesizing the FOMC minutes and PMI data into our Net Liquidity Model. We map the institutional footprint left over the week to establish the 'High-Conviction' zones and Divergence setups for the final trading week of May.
